reason: Fixed-point QAT combines squashed weight distributions and cosine regularization and quantizes transient variables for keyword-spotting models. Google Speech Commands and an in-house KWS set report 4-bit accuracy retention and 68% shorter execution time with fixed-point inference. This is a concrete embedded quantization method but for convolutional audio KWS, not transformer/LLM inference; linked low-bit relation is weak.
title: Fixed-Point Quantization Aware Training for on-Device Keyword-Spotting
